name: grill
description: Grill your decisions: an outside AI judge argues the strongest case against a decision or forecast. It is from a different company than Claude when Grill can tell that Claude wrote it.
long_description:
Say **"grill this"** in any chat. Claude sends the decision as you said it, with at most a few sentences of context, to an outside judge reached through a model router with your own key. The judge is from a different company than the one that wrote the plan, when Grill can tell which that is. When it cannot, the verdict says so.

The judge writes the strongest case for and against, names the cheapest test that would settle each challenge, and gives a verdict: holds, holds with conditions, weak, or refuted.

Every judge request asks for zero-data-retention endpoints only. The quality check request does not. A grill takes 1 to 3 minutes.

tools.name: grill
tools.description: Send a decision, plan or forecast, as you stated it, to an outside AI judge and get back a verdict, challenges and falsifiers.

tools.name: grill_result
tools.description: Collect a grill that was still running.

tools.name: grill_look_back
tools.description: Score pasted decision records against what happened. Stores nothing and needs no key.

tools.name: grill_feedback
tools.description: Tell Grill a grill helped or was meh. The grill text is sent only if you say yes.

openrouter_api_key.title: Model router key (OpenRouter)
openrouter_api_key.description: Create one at https://openrouter.ai/keys and add credit. It is masked, stored securely, and sent only to OpenRouter. Or leave it empty if GRILL_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY is already set. Grill reads GRILL_API_KEY first.

jev_quality_check.title: Quality check with Jev
jev_quality_check.description: Score every grill with Jev, one fixed decision model at TypeSafe, reached through the same model router: are the falsifiers real tests, does the verdict fit the challenges? It sees the masked write-up, your question, the verdict and the top five challenges. Its request carries no zero-retention flag. Grill relies instead on TypeSafe being the only provider of that model on OpenRouter, a weekly check that it is on OpenRouter's zero-retention list, and reading an answer only if TypeSafe served it. About $0.0002 a grill. Say skip the check to skip it for one grill. Turn off to send the write-up to the judge only.

judge_model.title: Judge model (optional)
judge_model.description: An OpenRouter model from a different company than the assistant you think with. One from the company Grill rules out is refused. Leave blank to use Grill's default, which lets the router pick the judge and leaves out your assistant's company when Grill can tell which that is, or Anthropic otherwise. An empty box is the same as blank.

show_news.title: Show Grill news
show_news.description: After a finished grill, at most once a session, show one line about a planned Pro plan, with a link to leave your email. Only within 7 days of a release, or on the first 3 days of a month, and never after 13 November 2026. The tool sends nothing. Turn off to hide the line.

usage_stats.title: Send anonymous usage stats (optional)
usage_stats.description: One metadata ping after a grill, never the decision, and only if you turn it on: https://github.com/mtangoz/grill/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY.md
